sys_hub_flow.description:
Given a Stash Id (sys_id) of a record in sys_repo_stash table, this Sub Flow will apply the stashed changes to the respective application.

Inputs:

  • Stash Id - Sys Id of the sys_repo_stash record.
  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance in which you apply the stashed changes.
  • Credential Alias - The connection and credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response.
  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”.
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled".
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.

To use this sub flow, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the instance URL used above Learn More

<p><strong>Inputs:</strong></p>
<ul>
   <li><strong>Stash Id</strong> - Sys Id of the sys_repo_stash record.</li>
   <li><strong>Instance URL</strong> - The URL of the Instance in which you apply the stashed changes.</li>
   <li><strong>Credential Alias</strong> - The connection and credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role</li>
   <li><strong>API Version</strong> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Outputs:</strong></p>
<ul>
   <li><strong>HTTP Status</strong> - The HTTP status code of the response.</li>
   <li><strong>Status</strong> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”.</li>
   <li><strong>Status Label</strong> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled".</li>
   <li><strong>Status Message</strong> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><strong>Status Detail</strong> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><strong>Error</strong> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
</ul>
<p>To use this sub flow, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the instance URL used above <a
